Hi Martin,
On November 1, EU customs will block products shipped without three required identifiers. That’s less than a week away.
If you are reading this email, our records indicate you still have PIDs to upload to Flavorcloud.
If your full catalog won’t be ready in time, prioritize the products that drive the most EU orders. Each one you complete is a product that keeps shipping.
Use our setup guide<····> to add the fields, then fill in your top sellers first.
Need help? Email (email hidden)<mailto:(email hidden)>.
The F. Team

[····]

Note to the team: Same FlavorCloud compliance blast as the October 13 and October 20 ones, now at five days out, addressed to Martin. Not a customer message, so no reply sent.
